header: Dispatch, field work and reporting in one place
subheadline: Most service companies run three systems that do not speak to each other: a shared calendar, a stack of paper job sheets, and a spreadsheet somebody rebuilds every month. These three pillars replace them.

items.title: Plan the day
items.description: Skills, distance and SLA clocks decide who takes which call, and the board tells the dispatcher what a reassignment would cost before they make it.

items.title: Record the work
items.description: Photos, readings, parts and a customer signature attach to the asset, not just to the invoice, so the next visit starts with the last one's findings.

items.title: See what it earned
items.description: Contract profitability per site and first-time fix rate per technician, so the annual repricing conversation runs on figures instead of impressions.
